digest.component_or_area: Jira status mapping and reconciliation core
propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded via built-in local_to_jira_status and jira_to_local_status with no echo-safe path for projects needing remaps or collapses
Outbound (CREATE/UPDATE) status field mapping must become per-project config-driven, reading from the S1 mapping_config layer and falling back to built-in when no project override exists
Unmapped local statuses must drift (omit the status field, leaving Jira unchanged) with a deduped non-fatal alert, never coerce or skip the mutation
All outbound status mutations must stamp rebar-status:<local> labels iff the config target differs from the built-in canonical reverse map, enabling inbound recovery without a reverse-map lookup
Inbound status recovery from rebar-status labels must use a derived vocabulary covering all possible local status names the outbound rule can emit, retiring the duplicated literal
Fetcher and preflight validation must tolerate config-declared status names in addition to built-in statuses
